decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core range costs little to keep in the catalogue, and nothing so far shows its value has failed, so the option stays open while the firm's broader handle range is trimmed elsewhere.

This single handle design is more expendable among many options and the website no longer shows it, but its holding cost is low and there is no clear negative signal, so abandoning it remains premature.
This design variant is cheap to maintain, and the missing website mentions do not by themselves show its value is lost, so keeping the option is still justified.
The flagship electronic access system remains a key growth option toward digital building organization, where uncertainty favours continued commitment rather than abandonment.
